title: Knowledge
subtitle: Create a knowledge base first, then upload documents and maintain FAQs inside it.
newHint: Choose a knowledge base or an FAQ knowledge base
copied: Copied as a new knowledge base
deleteBody: References from assistants and agents that mount it will show as invalid.
deleteBodyReferenced: References from assistants and agents that mount it will show as invalid. {{count}} assistants / agents are using it.
detailDefaultDescription: Governed knowledge content for assistants to retrieve.

syncLong.pending: Syncing the knowledge base to the knowledge engine; this updates automatically.
syncLong.failed: Syncing to the knowledge engine failed; it retries automatically, or retry now
syncLong.not_configured: The knowledge engine (Dify) is not configured. An administrator needs to configure it and retry the sync; content cannot be indexed meanwhile.

createSubtitle: Create a knowledge base first, then upload documents and maintain FAQs inside it.
name: Name
descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what the knowledge base contains and who it is for.

createHint.standard: Next, add documents and FAQs · both are managed inside this knowledge base.
createHint.faq: FAQs only · an FAQ knowledge base has no document upload or document retrieval.

settingsSubtitle: Type, retrieval and indexing defaults of this knowledge base.
switchedToFaq: Switched to an FAQ knowledge base
switchedToStandard: Switched to a standard knowledge base
typeBlocked: It has {{count}} documents, so it cannot become an FAQ knowledge base.
typeSwitchHint: A standard knowledge base without documents can become an FAQ one; existing FAQs are kept.
reindexBody: After changing the embedding model or chunking, all {{count}} documents go to “Processing” and the index is rebuilt; mounted assistants keep using the old index meanwhile.
thresholdHint: Only knowledge snippets at or above this similarity are returned
readOnly: You do not have permission to change knowledge base settings.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Files and web pages parsed, chunked and indexed only in this knowledge base.
documents.uploadHint: PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, TXT; up to 50 MB each, {{count}} at a time. You can also import web page URLs.
documents.urlsLabel: Web page URLs (one per line, public https)
documents.urlsHint: The server fetches the pages and indexes them; internal and loopback addresses are rejected.
documents.tooMany: At most {{count}} files at a time; the rest were ignored
documents.empty0: No documents yet. Click “Upload documents” to start.
documents.deleteBody: “{{name}}” is removed from the index and its original file is deleted.
documents.conflictTitle: A document with this name exists
documents.conflictBody: These files share a name with existing documents: {{names}}. Overwriting replaces the old document; keeping both numbers the new one.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Maintain standard Q&A. Only published FAQs are retrieved; drafts and expired FAQs never are.
faq.empty0: No FAQs yet. Click “New FAQ” or import a CSV.

sync.pending: Waiting to be pushed to the knowledge engine

faq.question: Question (≤200 chars)
faq.similar: Similar phrasings (Enter to add, up to 10)
faq.expiresHint: Valid through that day; it expires automatically the next day and stops being retrieved.
faq.questionInvalid: The question is required and at most 200 characters
faq.answerInvalid: The answer is required and at most 2000 characters
faq.published: FAQ published; pushing to the knowledge engine
faq.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from the knowledge engine.
faq.importHint: CSV columns: question, answer, similar phrasings (optional, separated by semicolons). A header row is optional; up to 500 rows.

basicsSubtitle: Define how this knowledge base appears and its default indexing language.

standard.title: Documents and FAQs come next
standard.body: After creation, documents and FAQs are managed inside this knowledge base.

faq.title: FAQs only
faq.body: This type does not provide document upload or document retrieval.
